note: The ladder of goals. The dashboard decides each stage's state from live data; 'manual' stages show the note until the owner sets criteria. Edit here.

ladder.label: A verified edge on shorts
ladder.why: Live record above break-even over many separate calls

ladder.label: An edge on longs
ladder.why: A long contestant beats the Arbiter on live results, judged by the locked judge

ladder.label: Reading the market type correctly
ladder.why: The market-type readers are right more often than not, graded 48 hours later

ladder.label: Consistent compounding
ladder.why: Many small wins, shallow drawdowns, no reliance on a few big ones

ladder.label: Running unattended
ladder.why: Hourly runs keep happening and parts repair themselves

ladder.label: Ready for real money
ladder.why: Passes the graduation and the December exam
ladder.manual: Graduation Nov 29-30 and the December exam. The pass criteria are for the owner to set before Dec 1.
